summary: Kill Trigger: the caster gains Blessing Against Wounds (ex), marked with a white strip.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: The caster becomes enchanted with Blessing Against Wounds as an Extraordinary ability (not the ability to cast it); it lasts as that Enchantment does.

requirements.note: Kill Trigger: within 30 seconds of a killing blow, outside 10' of living enemies, one per kill.

properties.note: A white strip denotes the Blessing Against Wounds.

clarifications.text: The caster must still wear a white strip to show the Blessing Against Wounds.

open_questions: Duration recorded as until-used on the reading that Blessing Against Wounds makes the bearer resistant to the next wound; the text itself gives no duration.
